analysis: The code calls checkNotNull on the result of mediaSessionCompat.getMediaSession(), which throws NullPointerException if null. The cast to android.media.session.MediaSession is safe because getMediaSession() returns that type. The setMediaButtonBroadcastReceiver method may throw runtime exceptions if broadcastReceiver is null, but that is a programming error. Runtime exceptions indicate bugs and should propagate to the caller; catching them within this snippet is unnecessary and may hide errors. Therefore, no exception handling optimization is needed.
